description: This file implements a repository layer for employee data management using SQLAlchemy ORM. It provides functions to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete employee records, including filtering and pagination features.

classes.name: EmployeeEmailAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when attempting to violate the email uniqueness constraint for employees.

methods.name: Select _apply_filters(stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optional[EmployeeStatus])
methods.description: Applies optional search, department, and status filters to a SQLAlchemy select statement.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Employee],int] list_employees( db: Session, page: int, size: int, search: Optional[str] = None, department: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[EmployeeStatus] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of employees, optionally filtered by search term, department, and status, along with total count.

methods.name: Optional[Employee] get_employee(db: Session, employee_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single employee record by ID.

methods.name: Employee create_employee(db: Session, data: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new employee record, handling unique email constraint violations.

methods.name: Employee update_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing employee, with error handling for email uniqueness.

methods.name: None delete_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee)
methods.description: Removes an employee record from the database.

ctags.name: _apply_filters
ctags.pattern: /^def _apply_filters(stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optio/
ctags.signature: (stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optional[EmployeeStatus])

ctags.name: list_employees
ctags.signature: ( db: Session, page: int, size: int, search: Optional[str] = None, department: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[EmployeeStatus] = None, )

ctags.name: update_employee
ctags.pattern: /^def update_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee, data: dict) -> Employee:$/
